paragraphs: The M3 CSL was a limited-run lightweight special built on the E46-generation M3, produced from 2000 to 2006. It uses the S54 — a 3.2-litre naturally aspirated inline-six that was also fitted to the standard E46 M3. The S54 is one of BMW M's most celebrated engines, known for its high-revving character and motorsport-derived architecture. Its rod bearing wear pattern is well-documented in the BMW M community, which is why we address it as standard on every S54 rebuild. The M3 CSL is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
